275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

279785354.description:
Paradise Pens of Hawaii
Koa Wood Ballpoint Pen
Late 20th Century, 1 Pen with Case
Paradise Pens of Hawaii specializes in writing instruments crafted from native Hawaiian hardwoods, emphasizing the natural beauty of the island's flora. This ballpoint pen is fashioned from Koa wood, a species endemic to the Hawaiian Islands that was historically reserved for Hawaiian monarchs. The warm, chatoyant grain of the Koa is complemented by gold-tone accents, reflecting the brand's commitment to Hawaiian craftsmanship and environmental reforestation projects.
Case label identifies manufacturer and "KOA" wood material origin
Barrel features custom cursive engraving: "To Mom Love, Jeff"
Gold-tone clip and accents with twist-action mechanism
Assembled in Hawaii with components marked "MADE IN TAIWAN" on the internal case mold
Condition:
Good pre-owned condition. The Koa wood barrel remains smooth with no cracks or structural damage. Note the personalized engraving as described. The gold-tone clip shows visible tarnish and light surface pitting consistent with age. Includes original plastic display case which shows moderate surface scuffing. Functionality verified; accepts standard ballpoint refills.
